srs_document.project_name: EduSphere School Management and LMS Platform
srs_document.system_category: School Management, LMS, Fees, Transport, Parent Portal and Admin Dashboard Web Application

app_summary.short_description: A complete school management platform with public landing website, student admission portal, parent portal, teacher dashboard, admin dashboard, LMS, attendance, timetable, exams, assignments, fee management, transport management, library management, notifications, reports, and staff management.
app_summary.business_goal: To digitally manage school operations including admissions, student records, classes, subjects, teachers, attendance, learning materials, assignments, exams, marks, fees, transport, parent communication, and administrative reports.

app_type.primary_type: School Management System and Learning Management System
app_type.frontend_type: Responsive SPA with optional PWA support

example_stack.file_storage: Cloud storage or local server storage
example_stack.realtime: WebSocket optional for live notifications and classroom updates

roles.description: Full system owner with access to all schools, branches, settings, users, reports, permissions, and audit logs.
Manages school setup, users, students, teachers, classes, subjects, timetables, fees, and system configuration.
Views complete school operations, academic progress, reports, staff performance, financial summaries, and approvals.
Manages academic structure, classes, subjects, timetables, exams, grading, learning materials, and academic reports.
Manages assigned classes, subjects, lessons, attendance, assignments, marks, student feedback, and LMS content.
Manages assigned classroom students, daily attendance, class notices, behavior notes, and parent communication.
Can view lessons, assignments, timetable, attendance, marks, notices, fee status, and submit assignments.
Can view child attendance, marks, timetable, notices, fees, payments, transport details, and communicate with school.
Manages fee invoices, payments, discounts, refunds, expenses, receipts, and financial reports.
Manages school buses, routes, drivers, student transport allocation, pickup points, and transport fees.
Manages library books, borrowing, returns, overdue fines, and library reports.
Can browse public school pages, view programs, submit admission inquiry, and contact the school.

data_type_standards.decimal: Money or numeric value with decimals

tables.description: Stores login accounts for students, parents, teachers, and staff.
Many-to-many relationship between roles and permissions.
Stores school profile and branch information.
Stores school grades or classes such as Grade 1, Grade 2, Grade 10.
Stores class sections such as Grade 6-A and Grade 6-B.
Stores subjects such as Mathematics, Science, English, ICT, and History.
Many-to-many relationship between students and parents.
Maps teachers to subjects and classes.
Stores assignment details created by teachers.
Stores school bus and transport vehicle details.
Stores library book borrow and return records.
Stores important system actions for security tracking.

relationships.description: Each user belongs to one role.
Each role can have many permissions.
One student can have many parents or guardians, and one parent can have multiple children.
Teachers can teach multiple subjects and subjects can be taught by multiple teachers.
One class has many timetable entries.
One student has many attendance records.
One subject has many LMS lessons.
One assignment can have many student submissions.
One exam has many student result records.
One student can have many fee invoices.
One fee invoice can have many payment records.
One transport route can have many student allocations.
One library book can have many borrow records.

sections: Hero section with school name, headline, admission CTA, and background image
Footer with contact details and quick links

restricted_functions: Access super admin only global controls

functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall display a public school website with home, about, admissions, academics, facilities, gallery, notices, and contact pages.
The system shall allow public users to submit admission inquiries without mandatory login.
The system shall authenticate students, parents, teachers, and staff using email and password.
The system shall restrict pages and actions based on user role and permission.
Authorized users shall be able to create, update, assign class, assign parent, deactivate, and view student profiles.
Academic coordinators shall be able to manage classes, sections, subjects, teachers, academic years, and timetables.
Teachers shall be able to mark and update daily student attendance.
Teachers shall be able to create lessons, upload learning materials, and publish LMS content to assigned classes.
Teachers shall be able to create assignments and students shall be able to submit assignments online.
The system shall allow exam creation, mark entry, grade calculation, result publishing, and student result viewing.
Accountants shall be able to generate fee invoices, record payments, apply discounts, add late fees, and print receipts.
Parents shall be able to view their children's attendance, marks, timetable, fees, notices, and transport details.
Transport managers shall be able to manage routes, vehicles, drivers, student allocations, and transport fees.
Librarians shall be able to manage books, issue books, return books, calculate fines, and generate library reports.
The system shall send notices, attendance alerts, assignment alerts, exam result alerts, and fee payment alerts.
The system shall generate student, attendance, exam, fee, teacher, transport, and library reports.
The system shall record important create, update, delete, login, payment, marks, attendance, and permission change actions.
The system should support mobile-friendly PWA behavior for students, parents, teachers, and staff.

business_workflows.workflow_name: Admission Inquiry to Student Enrollment Workflow
steps: Parent receives login details and fee notification
Teacher marks present, absent, late, or excused
System notifies parent if student is absent
Teacher attaches files and sets due date
Students and parents view graded result
Teachers enter marks for assigned subjects
System publishes results to student and parent portals
Parent views invoice in parent portal
Parent pays online or school records manual payment
System calculates overdue fine if late

validation_rules.rule: Must be valid email format and unique in users table.
Minimum 8 characters with at least one letter and one number.
Must be unique for each student.
Must be unique for each teacher or staff member.
Student count should not exceed section capacity unless override permission is granted.
Must be greater than assignment publish date.
Cannot be greater than total marks.
Cannot be negative and cannot exceed invoice balance unless overpayment is allowed.
Book cannot be issued if available copies are zero.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Dashboard pages should load within 3 seconds under normal network conditions.
Passwords must be securely hashed before storing in the database.
All protected API endpoints must validate authentication and role permissions.
Students and parents must only access their own academic and fee records.
The system should prevent duplicate attendance records for the same student and date.
Critical operations such as marks changes, fee payment changes, student updates, and permission changes must be saved in audit logs.
Database backup should be scheduled daily.
The system should support multiple schools, branches, academic years, and large student counts.
The system must be responsive for desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.
Code should be modular by feature: auth, students, academics, LMS, attendance, exams, fees, transport, library, reports, and settings.

security_requirements: Use role-based access control for all protected pages and API endpoints.
Validate all user input on frontend and backend.
Protect against SQL injection or NoSQL injection.
Protect against CSRF if session authentication is used.
Log important user actions in audit logs.
Prevent unauthorized access to student academic records.
Prevent unauthorized access to fee payment records.
Restrict financial reports to accountant, principal, admin, and super admin roles.
Restrict marks entry to assigned teachers and academic coordinators.
Parents must only access records of their linked children.
Students must only access their own records.

ui_ux_requirements.dashboard_layout: Sidebar navigation, top bar, summary cards, tables, filters, charts, calendar widgets, and notification cards
ui_ux_requirements.student_portal_layout: Simple student-friendly layout with lessons, assignments, timetable, results, and notices
ui_ux_requirements.parent_portal_layout: Child-focused dashboard with attendance, marks, fees, transport, and notices
required_components: Data tables with search and filters

acceptance_criteria: Public users can browse school pages and submit admission inquiries.
Admins can create students, parents, teachers, classes, sections, and subjects.
Teachers can mark attendance for assigned classes.
Students can view lessons, submit assignments, and view results.
Parents can view linked child attendance, marks, fee invoices, payments, transport details, and notices.
Academic coordinators can manage timetable, subjects, exams, and result publishing.
Accountants can generate fee invoices, record payments, and print receipts.
Transport managers can manage routes, vehicles, and student allocations.
Librarians can manage books, issue books, return books, and calculate fines.
The system prevents unauthorized access to student and fee records.
The system applies role-based access correctly.
All important actions are recorded in audit logs.
Reports can be filtered and exported.
The application works properly on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
future_enhancements: Mobile app for parents and students
